sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2. Learned A.G.A. submitted that notice has already been served upon the respondent.

3. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 346 of 2023 under Section 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act, Police Station Kerakat, District Jaunpur, with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant-accused is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Alleged incident of taking away of victim has been shown of 12.9.2023 but the first information report has been lodged after ten days on 23.9.2023.

In the F.I.R. age of victim is mentioned as 18 years and as per ossification test report, the age of victim is 19 years and thus the victim has to be treated as a major girl and the alleged age shown in the school record is wholly false.

Learned counsel for the applicant has referred statement of victim, recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., wherein she has stated that they used to talk with each other and that she has gone with applicant and he took her to a temple and there they performed marriage with each other.
Thereafter, they lived at the house of aunt of applicant and physical relations were established between them.
She has further stated that later on applicant has left her.

Learned counsel submitted that in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she has developed another version and stated that applicant has forcibly taken her away and he has forcibly married with her.
In the same statement she has also stated that before that incident applicant has established physical relationship with her consent.
Referring to facts of the matter, it was submitted that the victim had been a consenting party.
Victim has not sustained any injury.
Lastly it was submitted that applicant accused is languishing in jail since 29.9.2022.

5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the application and submitted that as per school record victim is a minor girl and in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she has made allegation of rape against applicant.

6. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, the period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

7. Let the applicant Manish Kumar, involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i.
The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii. The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
8. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.
Order Date :- 17.1.2024

Kumar Manish.
